summary: Iteration 11 — double fix validated: (1) MQTT alias normalization in mqtt_service._apply_update and (2) SVG <animateTransform> native animation in FancoilSchematicSVG. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass against real broker 156.67.82.199:1883. Published synthetic topics TJS/TESTDEV1/{COMANDO=1, MODO=0, ESTADO=true, CT=22.5, SETPOINT=24, PRESSAO=55, STATUS=1} and the registered CJ-TEST fancoil correctly reports cmd=True, modo=False, estado=True, temperature=22.5, setpoint=24.0, pressure=55.0, status=True. Malformed publishes (ESTADO='talvez', CT/SETPOINT/PRESSAO = non-numeric) do not crash the backend. For the 15 real CJs, 12/15 now expose at least one of estado/cmd/modo (CJ041: cmd=False/estado=True/modo=True; CJ062: cmd=False/estado=False/modo=True; CJ101: cmd=True/estado=True/temp=18.7°C/sp=18.5°C/pressure=60.0% — all were None before the fix). Frontend: verified both branches of the running flag via DOM inspection — CJ031 (status=None) renders fancoil-schematic without any <animateTransform>; CJ101 (status=True) renders <animateTransform type="rotate" dur="0.6s"> inside the <g key="spin-on"> group. The remount-on-status-change pattern works correctly. All indicators (CONDIÇÃO/COMANDO/QUADRO/STATUS/TEMP/SP/PRESSÃO/COMUNICAÇÃO) show real values on CJ101 and '--' on CJ031 as expected.

issues: Hero still reads 'Supervisório HVAC em Tempo Real' — minor leftover from NX-360 rebrand (iter10 also flagged similar strings)

critical_code_review_comments: mqtt_service._apply_update now accepts every known ESP32 variant — good. Consider adding a unit test at the module level (not just e2e via broker) so the alias table is pinned by tests.
FancoilSchematicSVG uses key={running ? 'spin-on' : 'spin-off'} to force remount — correct SMIL animation reset pattern. Native <animateTransform> works across all browsers.
seed_data_creation: Test created and then deleted a CJ-TEST fancoil mapped to device_id=TESTDEV1. TESTDEV1/TESTDEV2 entries are left in db.devices (detected-devices list) — harmless, cleared on backend restart.
